source_summary: Vertical ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with layered mountains, pine-dotted cliffs, misty valleys, terraced water, cottages, groves, a small pavilion by water, rocky banks, bridges, and willow-like foreground vegetation. Calligraphy, red seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: towering_pine_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-right mountain mass with steep rounded cliff faces, ink-wash striations, pale reserve highlights, and rows of dark pine dots along ridges and gullies. Exclude nearby red seal impressions.
must_preserve: arched contour strokes defining the cliff faces
layered grey wash texture and dry-brush streaks
dark pine-needle dots and clustered tree marks on ridgelines
mist-softened lower edges where the mountain descends

motifs.name: left_misty_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left sloping mountain ridge and distant pale peak behind it, including the soft atmospheric valley wash and overlapping ridge silhouettes. Avoid any red seals at the far left.
must_preserve: soft diluted ink washes fading into mist
curved ridge linework on the foreground slope
pale triangular distant peak in the center distance
subtle layered hills receding toward the valley

motifs.name: central_pine_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the rounded central hillside below the main peak, with pine-dotted slopes, curved texture strokes, and mist separating it from the valley floor.
must_preserve: black oval pine clusters following the slope
rounded cun-style texture strokes
soft wash gradations across the hillside
white mist pockets at the lower edge

motifs.name: right_cliff_village_path
motifs.description: Isolate the right middle cliff area with ledges, small roofed structures, a zigzag bridge or path, vertical waterfall-like pale drop, and terraced rock faces. Keep seals outside the extracted motif.
must_preserve: thin architectural roof geometry
zigzag bridge or walkway linework
vertical pale waterfall or cliff cleft
dark pine dots on ledges
angular rock texture strokes

motifs.name: midground_water_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the broad horizontal middle-ground water and marsh terraces with thin ink bands, reed strokes, rows of small trees, and pale open water reserves.
must_preserve: horizontal wash bands indicating water
short reed and grass ticks along banks
rows of dark vertical tree marks
pale unpainted water channels
soft transitions between water and mist

motifs.name: left_foreground_grove_cottages
motifs.description: Isolate the dense lower-left grove with tall bare and needled trees, bamboo-like foliage, dark shrubs, rocks, and low cottages with tiled roofs partially hidden among vegetation.
must_preserve: fine branch linework on bare trees
needle-like pine strokes
light bamboo leaves and dark shrub masses
simple cottage walls and slanted tiled roofs
foreground rock outlines and ink washes

motifs.name: waterside_pavilion_island
motifs.description: Isolate the small round-roof pavilion beside the water, its supporting posts, surrounding rocky island, adjacent open water, and nearby low bridge elements without taking the whole right bank.
must_preserve: conical pavilion roof with radiating rib lines
thin vertical support posts
rocky island contours and dark texture dots
pale water reserves around the structure
delicate bridge planks at the lower right edge

motifs.name: right_willow_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground bank with drooping willow-like branches, vertical trunk and brushy foliage, clustered rocks, and water-edge marks.
must_preserve: drooping willow branch linework
vertical trunk and dense dark foliage strokes
rounded rock clusters with dry-brush texture
water-edge ripples and pale negative space
small dark leaf accents near the shoreline

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
